slos.title: Recognise, find, name and write fractions of a length, shape, set of objects or quantity
slos.text: Recognise, find, name and write fractions: half (1/2), quarter (1/4), two-quarters (2/4), three-quarters (3/4) of a length, shape, set of objects or quantity using pictorial representations.

slos.title: Identify, name and write unit, non-unit, like and unlike fractions
slos.text: Identify, name and write: unit fractions, non-unit fractions, like fractions, unlike fractions of a discrete set of objects using pictorial representations.

slos.title: Compare and order unit fractions and like fractions
slos.text: Compare and order unit fractions and like fractions (with denominators up to 10) using <, > and = signs.

slos.title: Add and subtract like fractions within one whole
slos.text: Add and subtract like fractions within one whole (e.g., 1/4 + 3/4 = 4/4 = 1).

slos.title: Recognise proper, improper fractions and mixed numbers
slos.text: Recognise among: proper fractions, improper fractions, mixed numbers.

slos.title: Identify equivalent fractions and families
slos.text: Identify equivalent fractions and show families of equivalent fractions.

slos.title: Simplify fractions to lowest terms
slos.text: Simplify fractions to the lowest term.

slos.title: Compare and order like fractions using symbols
slos.text: Compare and order like fractions using symbols <, > and =.

slos.title: Add and subtract like and unlike fractions with common multiple denominators
slos.text: Add and subtract like and unlike fractions (with denominators that are multiples of the same number).

slos.title: Differentiate proper, improper fractions and mixed numbers
slos.text: Differentiate among: proper fractions, improper fractions, mixed numbers.

slos.title: Convert improper fractions to mixed numbers and vice versa
slos.text: Convert improper fractions to mixed numbers and vice versa.

slos.title: Compare and order unlike fractions and mixed numbers
slos.text: Compare and order unlike fractions, proper, improper fractions and mixed numbers in ascending and descending order.

slos.title: Add and subtract like and unlike fractions expressing answer as mixed numbers
slos.text: Add and subtract like and unlike fractions (with denominators that are multiples of the same number) and write the answer in mixed numbers (if applicable).

slos.title: Multiply and divide fractions by a whole number
slos.text: Multiply and divide proper, improper fractions and mixed numbers by a whole number.

slos.title: Multiply two fractions and/or mixed numbers
slos.text: Multiply two fractions and/or mixed numbers and express the answer in its simplest form.

slos.title: Solve real-world word problems involving fractions
slos.text: Solve real-world word problems involving fractions by identifying appropriate operations.

slos.title: Compare and order fractions and decimals
slos.text: Compare and order whole numbers, fractions and decimals.

slos.title: Add and subtract two or three unlike fractions and mixed numbers
slos.text: Add and subtract two or three unlike fractions and mixed numbers.

slos.title: Multiply and divide proper, improper fractions and mixed numbers
slos.text: Multiply and divide proper, improper fractions and mixed numbers and express the answer in its simplest form (if applicable).

slos.title: Solve real-world word problems involving fractions and decimals
slos.text: Solve real-world word problems involving fractions.
